newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pakistan seen tendering for 500,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seen tendering for 500,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: Pakistan is expected to tender next week for 500,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat for August-September shipment, European grain trade sources said on Wednesday.
"We are expecting them next week but there is nothing firm yet," one source said.
Sources said Pakistan was covered until at least end-July following recent wheat purchases.
"That would make sense. They normally come out for 500,000 tonnes," another source said.
In late June Pakistan bought 500,000 tonnes of wheat, including 350,000 tonnes from the U.S., 100,000 from Australia and 50,000 from Canada for July 11 to August 10 shipment.
